tools.name: find_referral_code
tools.description: Returns the verified referral code or referral link for one app (e.g. 'Underdog', 'Kling AI', 'Novig', 'Courtside', 'Muse'), with the exact field and moment to enter it, the sign-up destination and whether it carries the referral, the new user benefit, the steps, the conditions, and the verification

tools.name: list_referral_offers
tools.description: Lists active offers and clearly marked official-access entries. Set referrals_only to true to return only apps with a referral code or invitation.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_referral_offers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Lists every active referral offer (app, code, sign-up link, what the new user gets, verification date), optionally filtered by category: 'ai', 'sports', 'money' or 'all'." → after: "Lists active offers and clearly marked official-access entries. Set referrals_only to true to return only apps with a referral code or invitation."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
